one_line: Four numbered on-screen steps in one propped take, a held-back trick, then one comment word that delivers a file.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 selfie close-up: the mother looks at the lens while a baby on her lap drinks from a purple cup. Voiceover (transcript): "בואו לגלות מה הטריק שלי". Title pops in: "שתיה מקשית! חלק 2 - הטריק שלי!"; white box below.
q1_hook.why: A concrete age promise ("בגיל חצי שנה") and a result already on screen: the baby is drinking from the straw cup (H2, S1). Text lands at 0:00 with the voice, so it works sound on or off (T3, H6). Her face looks at the lens (H4). The trick is promised, not yet shown (H5).

beats.what: Selfie close-up, baby drinking from the purple cup; title and white headline box
beats.why: Result on screen first, trick promised

beats.what: Cut to a wide sofa shot; "ללמד עם בקבוק השתיה עם קשית עגולה וצרה", "בקובץ הקישורים לבקבוקים"
beats.why: Names the method and plants the link file early

beats.what: Step 1, dipping the straw in water; badge 1 and "טבלתי את הקשית במים"
beats.why: The number tells the viewer how many steps are left

beats.what: Step 2, the short end; badge 2 and "אטמתי את הצד הקצר"
beats.why: Same action with a small change, easy to follow

beats.what: Step 3, waiting for the baby to suck; badge 3; at 0:27 a finger points at the lens
beats.why: The pointed finger breaks the static take and speaks to the viewer

beats.what: Step 4, she drinks first from the bottle; flash at 0:31; "הטריק!"
beats.why: The held-back trick, marked by an effect
A happy reaction closes the demo

beats.what: "הגיבו בקבוק ותקבלו את קובץ הקישורים לבקבוקים מומלצים"
beats.why: The ask comes right after the reward moment

beats.what: "עקבו לתכנים נוספים בנושא התפתחות שפה ודיבור" with a Follow sticker

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Comment the word "בקבוק" for a file of recommended bottle links (on screen 0:41 to 0:45, said, and in the caption). Follow ask at 0:46. No question, tag or save ask.
q2_flow.why: Numbered steps give a countdown, and the trick is held back to step 4 at 0:29 (H5, R7). Each step brings new text and a hand action (R3), but one 20 s static take with similar moves is the sag (E2). The clap at 0:38 is a late payoff (R4), then 8 s of asks follow (R1).

q3_cta.what: 0:41 to 0:45, said and shown: "הגיבו בקבוק ותקבלו את קובץ הקישורים לבקבוקים מומלצים". The link file is teased at 0:10. Then a follow ask with a Follow sticker, 0:46 to 0:49. Caption repeats the comment word.
q3_cta.why: A comment word that delivers something real, a file of links, after the value is shown, said and written mid-frame in the safe zone (C3, C6, C2). The word is a plain product word, easy to type. A follow ask follows the CTA, a second action (C1).

q4_shown.what: 0:00 the baby drinks from the cup. 0:07 to 0:28 wide shot: bottle, straw parts, spoon and food on the table, her hands doing steps 1 to 3. 0:30 she drinks first. 0:38 the baby claps. No brand, price or link on screen.
q4_shown.why: The result comes first, then each step in order, so a viewer can copy it (S1, R3). A mother vouches in first person, and her job as a speech therapist sits only in the caption (S6). The baby's face is on screen throughout, which LumeBook's own Reels avoid (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 4 shots in 49 s: a 6 s selfie, a static wide take 0:07 to 0:27, then a closer crop. Text pops in with each step, within about 1 s of the voice. A black-and-white flash at 0:31. Ends on the follow card.
q5_edit.why: The number badges, bursts and one flash give rhythm where there are almost no cuts (E2). Text lands within about 1 s of the voice, which helps muted viewers (E4). The Reel ends on a follow card eight seconds after the payoff, a long tail (E8, R1).

q6_topic.what: A speech-language pathologist's four-step method for teaching a baby of about six months to drink from a straw. Serves parents who want a milestone tip and a bottle list.
q6_topic.why: A real milestone worry, answered with a usable tip wrapped in a mother and her baby, with a clap at 0:38 (K6, K4, K1). Numbered steps plus a free link file give a reason to save or send (R7, R5). The caption's health claim is hedged ("יכולה") but unchecked (K4).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld high-angle selfie, then a static wide shot: the mother on a white sofa with the baby on her lap, a table in the foreground; later a closer crop. Window daylight, at home. She looks at the lens and points at 0:27.
q7_filmed.why: Home, window light and a steady frame look like a real mother, not an ad (H8, F7). The wide shot shows the routine but makes the straw small, with the bottle in the bottom 35% (F4, F2). Looking at the lens at 0:27 speaks to the viewer (F6).

q8_text.on_screen: Yellow comic title at the top, 0:00: "שתיה מקשית! חלק 2 - הטריק שלי!"; white box about 60% down: "ככה לימדתי שתיה מקשית בגיל חצי שנה!". Purple outlined lines in the lower third: "ללמד עם בקבוק השתיה" (0:07), badges 1 to 4 with "טבלתי את הקשית במים" (0:15), "הטריק!" (0:31), "וההצלחה!" (0:39). White boxes mid-frame, 0:42 to 0:48: "הגיבו בקבוק ותקבלו את קובץ הקישורים לבקבוקים מומלצים".
q8_text.caption: "הבטחתי לכם את הטריק שעזר לי ללמד שתיה מקשית!". About 85 words, no hashtags, no disclosure: the promise, a hedged health claim, "הגיבו בקבוק בתגובות ותקבלו את הרשימה המלאה!", an introduction as a developmental speech therapist, a follow ask.
q8_text.why: A headline card at 0:00 states the topic (T3), and the steps are written out for a muted viewer (T1). But the step lines are full sentences of up to ten words, in the bottom 35% (T2, T4). The caption leads with the promise and has no hashtags (T7).

weak_points: The trick waits until 0:29; step lines are full sentences in the bottom 35%; the straw is small in the wide shot; two asks at the end; baby's face on screen; a hedged but unchecked health claim in the caption.
lumebook_takeaway: Film a propped phone on a table, hands only: numbered steps on screen, the payoff last, then one comment word that delivers a free guide.
not_verified: The bottle brand; whether the link file holds affiliate links or there is a deal (no disclosure visible); how the file is delivered after the comment; whether the water moves through the straw (not visible); music (cannot hear). Correction to src/coded: frames show a closer crop from about 0:27, so about 4 shots, not 3 (cannot tell a cut from a digital zoom). The baby's name is spoken in the transcript and left out here.
